title: slack-notice notification (send --stdin-json, --file)
description: One notification. Unknown fields exit 20 invalid_payload. Text limits are applied after sanitizing by the tool; the bounds here only cap the raw input. Flag input (--title, --message, --level, --link) forms the same object.

title.description: Untrusted. One line (newlines become spaces); at most 256 characters after sanitizing, cut with an ellipsis and truncated: true when longer (not refused). Input over 100000 characters exits 20 invalid_payload.

message.description: Untrusted. At most 100000 characters of input; empty after sanitizing exits 20 empty_message.

link.description: Untrusted. Checks only the syntactic gate: http or https, no userinfo, no whitespace or control characters, at most 1024 characters. The tool, not the schema, names a violation: another scheme exits 20 with reason link_scheme, any other violation reason link_invalid.
